[[File:Doom E3M8 map.png|thumb|Map of Dis]]
If you collected the BFG on a previous map, rush the Spider Demon Mastermind with that weapon - it will fall in only two hits. It is possible to kill it with just 1 shot at close range.

If you are starting with only a pistol and 50 bullets, you will need to use the available supplies, which is a lot more limited, with only a few Rockets and plasma cells available. As with the cyberdemon, the spider mastermind is immune to blast damage from rockets. Run forward to collect the rocket launcher, and make a hard left turn. Keep running along the edge until you collect sufficient ammo, which should be when you reach the stairs. Then, run to the center, and open the center room to collect the blue armor and plasma gun.

Do not bother wasting ammo on the Cacodemons and the Baron (harder difficulties). Because the Spider Mastermind has a super chaingun / shotgun combo as a weapon, the pellets will eventually hit any of the 2-3 enemies, forcing an infight. Let them infight with the Spider Mastermind so that you can shoot the distracted Mastermind. If you decided to fight each monster individually, you will not have enough ammo to defeat the Spider Mastermind unless you are playing on the easiest difficulty which gives you 2 times the ammo.

In addition, it is possible to defeat the spider mastermind by triggering monster infighting. You will need to have the mastermind hit both cacodemons and the baron of hell (which is not possible on Easy). If done correctly, the spider mastermind will either be weakened significantly or defeated by the three other monsters.

== Secrets ==
There are no secrets on the map, beyond the helpful tip of opening the middle pillar for a plasma gun and blue armor.

== Deathmatch ==
This map isn't designed for deathmatch. There are only the two weapons, and a single blue armor in the middle, and one of these weapons is hard to reach.
